title: Capilano Suspe Bridge & Grouse Mountain Limited Small Group Tour
includes: Luggage Allowance (1 checked bag per person)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Limited to 8 guests per departure, this small group tour offers a relaxed and more personal way to experience two of Vancouver's most iconic North Shore attractions.

At Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, cross the legendary suspension bridge, explore the treetop walkways, and enjoy views from the Cliffwalk. Continue to Grouse Mountain to ride the Skyride gondola, visit the resident grizzly bears, and experience the seasonal world famous Lumber Show. 

A well-balanced experience with fewer crowds and more personal space - ideal for travelers who want comfort, a balanced itinerary, and appreciate connection and unforgettable mountain views in a half-day adventure. 

SEMI-PRIVATE TOUR: 
* Maximum 8 Guests GUARANTEED
* More INTIMACY, More CONNECTION
* More Space, More COMFORT
* SMOOTHER Experience
* OPTIMIZED - More Time At Key Attractions
* BALANCED PACE - no Rush, no Crowds
* Light Snacks & Bottled Water INCLUDED
